source_refs.note: Nuclear Fission: a main subheading of 31.8 Nuclear Energy - Fission and Fusion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 228-228.

blocks.text: Fission woh process hai jis mein uranium-235 ya plutonium-239 jaisa heavy (bhari) nucleus do lighter (halke) nuclei mein toot jata hai; is mein energy, neutrons aur radiations paida hoti hain. Nikalne wale neutrons aage aur nuclei ko tor sakte hain; is silsile (process) ko chain reaction kehte hain.
Uranium-235 aur aik neutron ka nuclear reaction yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Aik neutron (n) U-235 nucleus se takrata hai; nucleus Ba-141 aur Kr-92 mein toot'ta hai, '+ energy', aur teen neutrons nikalte hain. Har neutron aage aik aur U-235 nucleus tak jata hai: chain reaction.
blocks.caption: Uranium-235 ka fission aur chain reaction (hamari apni drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Nuclear power plants electricity banane ke liye fission bohat use karte hain. Thore se fuel se bohat zyada energy milti hai, lekin is ki serious drawbacks (sangeen khamiyan) bhi hain. Is se radioactive waste (kachra) banta hai jise lambe arse tak bohat ehtiyat se sambhalna parta hai. Nuclear accidents (haadson) ka khatra bhi hai; history (tareekh) mein in ke consequences (nataij) dekhe ja chuke hain, jaise Chernobyl (1986) aur Fukushima (2011). In accidents ne environment aur insani health ko sakht nuqsan pohanchaya.
